title: Directions across parts
description: Rehearsal marks and sections are score-wide: they live on the global measure and apply to every part, so they are stated once however many parts a score has. A direction is part-specific. Here only the first part is told to play the passage solo, while both parts share the rehearsal mark and the section name. Proposed MNX objects, not yet adopted — see roadmap/proposed/score-text.md.
